10.title: Button
10.body:
Button variant Visual emphasis preset. `default` is the primary action, `destructive`
is for irreversible actions, `outline` and `secondary` are quieter,
`ghost` is borderless, `link` looks like body-text underlined. size Height + horizontal padding preset. `sm` is 32px, `default` is 36px,
`lg` is 40px, `icon` is square 36×36 for icon-only buttons (always
pair with `aria-label`). asChild Render as a Radix Slot — forwards className and behaviour onto the
immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper `<button>`.
Common pattern for using a router `<Link>` while keeping the Button
styling. children Visible label or any nested elements (icons, badges). className Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root element via `cn()`. disabled When true, dims the button to 50% opacity and blocks pointer/keyboard
input. type Native HTML button type. `submit` triggers parent form submission;
`reset` resets parent form fields; `button` does neither. onClick Click handler. Receives a `MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>`. name Form name when this button submits/resets a form (for forms with multiple buttons). value Form value sent with the form when this button is the submitter. form ID of the form this button belongs to, when the button sits outside
the `<form>` element. tabIndex Tab order. Default behaviour is one of native `<button>` tab focus. aria-label Accessible label, required for icon-only buttons (`size="icon"`). aria-describedby ID of an element that describes the button's purpose.

14.title: Input
14.body:
Input pattern Native HTML5 validation regex. Triggers `:invalid` if the value doesn't match. type Native input type. Drives keyboard, validation, and on iOS the
picker. value Controlled value. Pair with `onChange`. For uncontrolled inputs use
`defaultValue` instead. defaultValue Initial value for an uncontrolled input. Ignored if `value` is also passed. placeholder Hint text shown when the input is empty. Renders in `text-muted-foreground`. disabled Visually dims to 50% and blocks all input. Pair with `Label` so the
dim cascades. readOnly Selectable but not editable. Useful for displaying server-set values. required Block native form submit unless the input has a value. name Form field name. Required when relying on uncontrolled native form submission. id DOM id. Match this from `<Label htmlFor>` for screen-reader association. autoComplete Browser autofill hint. See MDN for the full token list. autoFocus Focus the input on mount. Use sparingly — surprises keyboard users. maxLength Character count limit for text inputs. minLength Minimum character count for text inputs. min Numeric / date lower bound. Honoured by `type="number"` / `"date"` / `"time"` / `"range"`. max Numeric / date upper bound. step Step increment for `number` / `range` / `date` types. onChange Fires on every keystroke. Read `e.target.value`. Required if you pass `value`. onFocus Focus event. Common for focus-driven typeahead lookups. onBlur Blur event. Common for blur-validation. className

15.title: Label
15.body:
Label htmlFor ID of the form control this label describes. Sets `for` on the
underlying `<label>` so screen readers and click-to-focus work.
Match this with the input's `id`. asChild Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<label>`. children Label text. Can include nested elements (icons, helper text). className Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the label via `cn()`.

16.title: BrandMark
16.body:
BrandMark path SVG path data (`d` attribute) for the brand mark. Required — canvas
does not ship a default brand shape; consuming apps supply their own. viewBox SVG `viewBox` matching the path's coordinate space. transform Optional inner `transform` applied to the path's `<g>` group — useful
when the path coordinates need to be translated, rotated, or scaled
relative to the viewBox. from Gradient start colour. When omitted, the path is filled with
`currentColor` and no gradient is generated. to Gradient end colour. Required when `from` is set.

19.title: ScrollArea
19.body:
ScrollArea type When the scrollbar is shown:
- `"hover"` reveals on hover and 600ms after scroll
- `"scroll"` reveals only while scrolling
- `"auto"` defers to OS conventions (always-visible on Linux/Win)
- `"always"` keeps the scrollbar visible at all times scrollHideDelay How long the scrollbar lingers after scroll/hover ends, in ms. Only
applies when `type` is `"hover"` or `"scroll"`. dir Reading direction. Affects which side the vertical scrollbar lives on. asChild Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`. children Scrollable content. className Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root via `cn()`. Set the
height/max-height here so the scroll area knows when to scroll. orientation Which axis the scrollbar controls. forceMount Force the scrollbar to mount even when it's not needed (no overflow).
Pair with a CSS animation that fades in/out based on `data-state`. asChild Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`. className Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the scrollbar via `cn()`.

20.title: Section
20.body:
Section spacing Vertical-rhythm step applied as `space-y-*` between immediate children.
Maps to Tailwind's spacing scale: `0` = 0, `1` = 8px, `2` = 16px,
`3` = 24px, `4` = 32px, `5` = 40px, `6` = 48px. children Section content — typically a heading + body, or stacked cards. className Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root `<div>` via `cn()`. id DOM id, useful when linked to from a `<Label>` or anchor `#hash`. role ARIA role override. Pass `"region"` (paired with `aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby`) when the section should be a navigable landmark
for screen-reader users. aria-label Accessible label for landmark-role sections. aria-labelledby ID of an element that labels the section (e.g. its heading). aria-describedby ID of an element that describes the section.
